official_training_route: MuJoCo-Warp PPO requires CUDA; official README estimates 1–2 h with 4096 environments
measured_cpu_route: Full CPU MuJoCo/BAM with 4 processes, native 10-action PPO
notes: Throughput varies with contact/motion and concurrent load. No paid GPU resources were provisioned. A brief 8-process benchmark was faster; concurrent training/evaluation caused a worker exit, so subsequent runs are resource-limited to four processes and heavy phases are serialized.
